answer: The meadow counter is kept in onyx and lantern shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 179 dollars in locked collateral and another 4 days of waiting.
